evidence.detail: An earlier ad for the same unit codes 2 bedrooms and gives 1,642 square feet against this ad's 1,646, and its text states that count: Listing 2585067 text: "(2) Bedroom / (2.5) Bathroom residence".

Ad text: "spacious 2-bedroom 2.5 bathroom corner unit". The row codes a studio at 1,646 square feet. Sonnet read of the unit's ads: The row says unit 14H at The Lucida is a 2-bedroom 2.5 bath. Earlier ads for 14H code 2.
An earlier ad for the same unit codes 5 bedrooms and gives 2,900 square feet against this ad's 3,800, and its text states that count: Listing 4779852 text: "5 bed/3,5 bath Triplex".

Ad text: "5 Beds". The row codes a studio at 3,800 square feet. Sonnet read of the unit's ads: The row advertises a five bedroom triplex at 308 Clifton Place. A June 2025 ad for the same triplex codes 5.
